subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “By the end of the month, several students changed small habits.”?
options: Reuse showed that large buildings do not have to become empty shells when their first purpose ends.
The reef was small in the tank, but it showed a large idea: protecting one habitat can protect many lives at once.
But it showed that change becomes easier when people can see it, count it, and do it together.
The diary showed that climate is a large issue, but daily choices are part of the large picture.

本文可直接核對「By the end of the month, several students changed small habits. The diary showed that climate is a large issue, but daily…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「By the end of the month, several students changed small habits. The diary showed that climate is a large issue, but daily choices are…」，答案為「The diary showed that climate is a large issue, but daily choices are part of the large picture.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The diary showed that climate is a large issue, but daily choices are part of the large picture.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
